invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new Value object, so result is never null.
Percentages are typically non-negative; the intended use is as a proportion of height.

If get is called with null Actor, the method actor.getHeight() would throw a NullPointerException, but the invariant holds if get properly handles null or always returns 0 for null input, as suggested by defensive programming.
The returned object is always an instance of Value.
A reasonable upper bound for percent in the context of UI values, usually < 100%.
